answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because summit only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, ledge is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
